question: Paano kinukwenta ang Fire Safety Inspection Fee (FSIF) para sa FSIC ng Occupancy at magkano ang minimum na bayad?
answer:
The Fire Safety Inspection Fee (FSIF) for a Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) for Occupancy is not explicitly stated in the provided sources. However, the fee for other services like Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) is not mentioned either, so it might not be included in the provided sources. [S5]

The minimum payment for FSIC for Occupancy is also not specified in the provided sources. [S1, S2, S3, S4, S5]

ground_truth: Under the BFP Citizen's Charter and RA 9514, the Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) for Occupancy Permit requires: 1) Endorsement from the Office of the Building Official (OBO); 2) Certificate of Completion; 3) As-built plans (if changes occurred); 4) Certified true copy of the assessment fee from OBO; and 5) Fire insurance policy (if any). The Fire Safety Inspection Fee (FSIF) is assessed at 15% of all regulatory fees charged by the LGU, but in no case shall the fee be lower than Five Hundred Pesos (PHP 500.00).
